format: single Studio franchise (approx. 1,750 to 4,800 sq ft leased; typical 3,100 sq ft)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of an ORANGETHEORY ® franchised business is $764,577 to $1,104,920. This includes $182,658 to $237,994 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay us an initial franchise fee equal to $59,950 for a single Studio franchise (the "Initial Franchise Fee"), paid in full when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Fees paid in 2025 ranged from $0 to $59,950. Area Development: 3 locations $150,000 ($135,000 veteran or existing franchisee, $121,500 existing veteran), 5 locations $237,500, additional +$47,500 each.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee (2) 8% of Gross Sales Weekly See Note 3 for the definition of Gross Sales. We will debit your bank account for the Royalty due.

adFund.quote: Brand Fund Contributions Currently, 3% of Gross Sales. May be increased up to 5% of Gross Sales. Monthly
adFund.note: Currently 3%, up to 5%. Minimum Monthly Local Advertising Spend: greater of 2% of the prior month's Gross Sales or $2,500. Pre-sale and grand opening advertising $36,000 to $45,000.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $899 per month, plus a $575 Management Software setup fee. The monthly fee is subject to an annual increase of 10%, compounded

otherRecurring.name: OTbeat Fees
otherRecurring.amount: $149 per month and a one-time setup fee of $250 (may increase up to $500 per month)

otherRecurring.name: Minimum Monthly Local Advertising Spend
otherRecurring.amount: Greater of 2% of the Studio's Gross Sales from the prior month or $2,500

otherRecurring.name: Product and Other Promotional Item Purchases

transferFee.amount: 50% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee for new franchisees for a Control Transfer. 25% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee for all other transfers (other than transfers to an Entity formed to operate the Studio).

special: Minimum performance standards: Gross Sales of $300,000 (year 1), $350,000 (year 2), $400,000 (year 3 and after); if not met you must pay the royalty shortfall as if the standard had been met. Fitness equipment, OTbeat system and retail merchandise must be bought from affiliate OTF Sourcing ($114,323 to $158,624 for equipment).
issues: Transfer fee usd computed as 50% of the $59,950 Initial Franchise Fee (Control Transfer); not printed as a dollar amount. Company count is affiliate-owned Studios (franchisor operates none). Technology/OTbeat annualUsd computed as monthly x 12 before the 10% annual increases.
